name.en: Fake bank message with an APK: “update KYC” or “redeem reward points today”

how.en: An SMS or WhatsApp message in a bank's name says your account or YONO app will be blocked unless you update KYC, PAN or Aadhaar, or that reward points worth thousands of rupees expire today. It asks you to tap a link or install an app sent as an .apk file. The app is malware: it reads your OTPs and SMS and lets the fraudsters empty your account. Banks never send APK files or KYC links by SMS or WhatsApp.

text.en: A message in your bank's name says your account will be blocked or points expire today.
It looks like it comes from SBI, YONO or another bank.
It asks you to install an .apk file or open a link to update KYC or redeem.
The app or page asks for card details, OTP or net banking password.
Dear customer, your bank KYC is pending and your account will be suspended within 24 hrs. Install the KYC Update app to continue banking: [link] (KYC_Update.apk)
Your credit card reward points worth Rs 7,450 will lapse tonight! Download the Rewards app and redeem as cash in your account: [link]

en: sbi reward points will expire today message
yono account will be blocked update pan
message asked me to install apk to redeem points
kyc update link from bank on whatsapp
account will be suspended kyc pending link
Any APK file sent by SMS or WhatsApp.
Reward points paid “as cash in your account”.
Don't open the link or install the file; delete it.
Check KYC or rewards only in your bank's official app or branch.
If you installed it, switch off mobile data, call your bank to block cards and net banking, and call 1930.
